title: AFLW Grand Final
metaDescription: AFLW Grand Final: verified dates, location and OneSliders event context for Aussie Rules.

overview.about: The AFLW Grand Final decides the premiership of the AFL Women's competition, the elite national league for women's Australian rules football launched in 2017. Rapidly growing in profile and crowds, it is the showpiece of one of the country's fastest-rising sports.
overview.nextEvent: The next AFLW Grand Final is hosted by the higher-placed finalist, pitting the season's two best women's clubs against each other for the premiership. Brisbane and Adelaide have been among the competition's early powerhouses.
